title: Hearty Holiday Middle Eastern Pecan Nuts Knafeh
description: A funky and festive Middle Eastern dessert featuring pecan nuts, this knafeh is perfect for the holidays, and is macrobiotic-friendly and restorative.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the semolina flour, sugar, and melted ghee.
Add the chopped pecan nuts, rose water, and orange blossom water to the bowl and mix well.
In a separate bowl, crumble the akawi cheese and set aside.
Layer the phyllo dough in a large baking dish, brushing each layer with melted ghee.
Spread the semolina mixture over the phyllo dough, followed by the crumbled akawi cheese.
Repeat the layering process until all ingredients are used, ending with a layer of phyllo dough on top.
Bake the knafeh in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the knafeh from the oven and let it cool before serving.
